long_description:
SUSANNA CAGLE: WWW.ATTUNE.YOGA [ http://www.attune.yoga]

Susanna is a sound therapist specializing in tuning forks, gong, and singing bowls to restore energetic balance, regulate the nervous system, and support emotional healing. Her work combines somatic and spiritual practices to help clients process stored emotions and navigate chronic pain, anxiety, depression, PTSD, fatigue, and major life transitions. She also facilitates immersive sound baths creating spaces for deep rest, balance, and wellbeing of mind, body, and spirit. She is trained in protocols by Acutonics, Biofield Tuning, Atma Buti School of Vibrational Medicine, and studies gong with Roger Tjoelker and Wayne Marto. Outside her practice, Susanna is a student of herbalism and spends her free time racing gravel bikes and collecting lava lamps.

JEFFRI LYNN CARRINGTON: 

With 25 years of devotion to her craft as a professional vocalist in a wide range of genres, Jeffri Lynn Carrington’s ethereal, angelic, and deeply tender human voice creates a felt sense of being held in open arms of love. She infuses each note with pure presence, soul and heartfelt intention to help people feel loved, at peace, and safe to experience the fullness of emotion.

ROSE PHILLIPS: 

I have been singing since the very first cry that emerged from my mother’s womb. Voice has always been a way I listen, express, remember, and connect with myself, with others, and with the unseen realms that surround us.

For the past five years, I have been devoted to the practice of sound healing and sound baths, exploring the profound ways vibration, resonance, voice, and music can support us in returning to ourselves. I also work one-on-one with people through sound healing, creating intimate spaces for deep listening, release, restoration, and connection.
